FBI Investigated Senator Collins in Bribery Probe, Reports Say

The FBI investigated Republican Senator Susan Collins in relation to a bribery probe, according to reports. The investigation reportedly focused on allegations made by Martin Kao, the former CEO of Navatek, who is accused of bribery. Kao allegedly made these accusations as he sought to reduce his prison sentence. Collins' office has denied new details of these allegations.
